split: sklearn train_test_split: outer random_state=seed; inner random_state=1000+seed

spectral.parameterization: ordered cumulative exp frequencies; orthonormal trace-zero symmetric A; exact torch.matrix_exp(A/2) normalized root; log bandwidth
spectral.objective: MSE on disjoint support/query episodes sampled from inner training only; differentiate exact support KRR
spectral.validation: All inner-training rows, uniform training landmarks, centered Nystrom ridge path; every 50 steps and initialization
spectral.final_refit: Freeze geometry and preprocessing; select rank/ridge on validation; fit centered Nystrom ridge on all outer-training rows

trees.search: Fixed scrambled Sobol design plus a default-like first candidate
trees.final_refit: Selected hyperparameters and iteration count, all outer-training rows

comparison: Same row splits and target labels; different search counts/compute are reported, not equal-compute HPO
scope: Single-table regression test of the identifiable geometry, not pretrained cross-table transfer
evaluation: No outer-test labels used for model selection; no post-test hyperparameter adaptation
